title: VOLVO FUPS Wild Bar Road Train Custom Built Aluminium Bullbar #41
description: Series 4 FM FH Volvo FUPS Bullbar for Wild Bar style suitable for radar attachments. 75mm hi-tensile 6mm wall tube with heavy duty uprights, contoured to compliment the new cab shape. Reversible Road Train signs. Combination Indicator repeater, Parking light & Daylight Running LED lights mounted in main upright. The height of the bar allows the front panel to be lifted for daily checks. Hi-tensile aluminium backing plate, same tensile strength as steel.
